title: Lambda function fails with Runtime.CallbackHandlerDeprecated after switching to the Node.js 24 runtime
symptoms: errorType Runtime.CallbackHandlerDeprecated in CloudWatch, invocation returns FunctionError Unhandled
Init log warning: AWS Lambda plans to remove support for callback-based function handlers starting with Node.js 24
Handler written as (event, context, callback) worked on nodejs22.x
cause: The Node.js 24 runtime dropped the handler form that takes a third callback argument. Older runtimes still accept it, so the break appears only on the runtime upgrade.
fix: Make the handler async and return the result or throw the error. If the callback parameter is declared but never used, just remove it from the signature.
affected: Lambda nodejs24.x and later, since Node.js 24 became available in Lambda in November 2025; nodejs22.x and earlier unaffected
